blockers.title: Frontend Cost Components Exist But Are Never Rendered
blockers.description: Six well-structured cost components (CostDisplay, ProjectCostSummary, FeatureCostBadge, DesignCostRow, BudgetPausedLabel) were created but are not imported or rendered in any page. Users cannot see cost data in the UI.
blockers.recommended_fix: Import and render ProjectCostSummary in Dashboard.tsx. Add BudgetPausedLabel for workflows with paused_by === 'budget'.

fixes.title: paused_at Not Cleared in Budget Resume Flow
fixes.description: PUT /projects/{id} clears paused_by, status, and status_reason but NOT paused_at when raising limit. Causes data inconsistency.
fixes.recommended_fix: Add wf.paused_at = None to the budget resume loop.

fixes.title: _run_one_feature Returns 'failed' for Budget-Blocked Features
fixes.description: Budget-blocked features return 'failed' status, which is semantically incorrect and may trigger incorrect state transitions.
fixes.recommended_fix: Return 'skipped' or add a distinct 'budget_blocked' return value.

fixes.title: task_id Not Threaded to System-Wide LLM Calls
fixes.description: enrich_task(), analyze_agent_state(), analyze_agent_trajectory(), and review_qa_report() have task context available but don't pass task_id to _invoke_and_record(). Costs go to overhead bucket.
fixes.recommended_fix: Thread task_id through methods that receive task_info dict or have task context.

fixes.title: pick_next_design Returns None Immediately on Budget Check
fixes.description: Budget guard in pick_next_design() returns None immediately, blocking ALL designs including those from under-budget projects in multi-project setups.
fixes.recommended_fix: Change return None to continue to allow checking other projects.

defers.title: No Pagination on Cost Query Endpoints
defers.description: Cost query endpoints return all data without pagination. Could produce large responses for projects with many designs.

defers.title: datetime.utcnow() Deprecation
defers.description: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12+. All 52 tests emit deprecation warnings.

defers.title: Test Coverage for Orchestrator Integration
defers.description: TestBudgetAutoResumeBlocked only asserts on state, doesn't call actual guard functions to verify behavior.

defers.title: LangChain Response Metadata Smoke Test
defers.description: usage.include=true path not smoke-tested against live OpenRouter. If field path doesn't match, all direct cost recording silently produces $0.

overall_assessment: Backend implementation is solid and architecturally compliant. Frontend integration gap is the primary blocker. Data integrity issue in budget resume flow needs fixing. Multi-project budget guard logic has an early-return bug.
